en.title: Spring release roundup: selected platform and AI baselines

claims.text: The Spring Boot team announced 4.1.0 availability from Maven Central and says it includes fixes from Spring Boot 4.0.7. This summary covers that platform release rather than every project in the original roundup.

evidence.quote: It also includes all of the bug fixes, documentation improvements and security fixes from Spring Boot 4.0.7
Spring Boot 4.1.0 has been released and is now available from Maven Central.

claims.text: The Spring AI team announced 2.0.0 availability from Maven Central. Its documented baseline is Spring Boot 4.0 / 4.1 with Spring Framework 7.0, so applications should review compatibility before upgrading.

evidence.quote: Spring AI 2.0 has been designed to be used with Spring Boot 4.0 / 4.1 and Spring Framework 7.0
Spring AI 2.0.0 has been released and is now available from Maven Central!
